sv.title: Nibe-chefen: ”Proppen har verkligen gått ur”
sv.summary: Nibes gradvisa återhämtning från 2024 har fortsatt och under 2026 har det börjat lossna, vilket tisdagens kvartalsrapport vittnar om enligt värmeteknikbolagets finanschef Hans Backman. ”Proppen har verkligen gått ur”, säger han – men aktien backar.

en.title: Nibe chief: "The cork has really come out"
en.summary: Nibe's gradual recovery since 2024 has continued, and in 2026 it has begun to loosen, as Tuesday's quarterly report shows, according to the heat-technology company's CFO Hans Backman. "The cork has really come out," he says, but the share is falling.
